name: call-contact
title: Call Contact
description: Instant, zero-latency search for your Apple Contacts. Call, Message, FaceTime, or WhatsApp directly from Raycast with smart frequency sorting.
author: chanjot_nanda

preferences.name: priorityMessage
preferences.title: Priority Message Template
preferences.description: Message to pre-fill when using Priority Call

preferences.name: hideRecents
preferences.label: Hide Recently Contacted
preferences.description: Only show Favorites in the empty state

preferences.name: recentLimit
preferences.title: Recent Contacts Limit
preferences.description: Max number of recent contacts to show (Default: 15, Max: 100)

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
